item.title: Weekly Meeting 11/5: Cyber in Industry and Research
item.description: Hello everyone, are you interested in pursuing cybersecurity as a career option, or are you considering opportunities for internship or research before you graduate? Tomorrow we will be hosting a meeting involving shared experiences our members have with these opportunities and tips on how to navigate the cyber job market. The meeting will be led by Luke, Marshall, Enoch, and Hemant who all have experience with either internship, full-time, or research work in cyber. We hope that conversations like these can be helpful to our members as some of us move closer to entering the job market!

item.title: Weekly Meeting 9/3: Cyber Tools
item.description: This week we will continue with topics for people getting into cyber by introducing some relevant tools that are used in industry, education, and competitions. The meeting will be led collaboratively by Marshall, Luke, and Jon who will share their experiences and know-how when it comes to using some of these tools. If you are interested in participating in any of the events/competitions we will be hosting this semester, or if you are curious about what tools are relevant to previous competitions you have participated in, we highly recommend you attend.

item.title: Upcoming Events!
item.description:
Welcome back, AUEHC is starting up for the spring! See below for for details!

January 23rd @ 5:00 pm - EHC is having our first meeting of the semester! Tyler will be giving a talk on personal privacy. We hope to see you there!

February 6th @ 5:00 pm - We will be introducing a Social Engineering QR code event.

As you can see, we are starting off the semester with some really cool events. We hope to see you there!
